title: Telex Watcher (external deterministic watch loops)
summary: On 2026-10-25 Campaign accepted terminal delivery of watcher-cli-ux (#179): PR #180 merged as 0d5347a6 with operator approval, main CI 40223537702 passed 21/21, and the field report https://github.com/lossyrob/telex/issues/179#issuecomment-6401968111 retains accepted debt. The Watcher coordinator completed watcher-cli-ux; five-minute-custom-watch-gate has both dependencies completed and is pending with the operator. closure-gate still waits on runtime-hardening and watcher-macos-containment-runtime (#172), whose HOLD is unchanged. Earlier in-progress text below is historical. On 2026-10-25 Campaign and owning Local accepted #181 delivery (PR #185 merged as 65f5846d; main CI 40217242404 passed 24/24; field report https://github.com/lossyrob/telex/issues/181#issuecomment-6401070057), releasing only watcher-cli-ux's Local prerequisite. The Watcher coordinator moved watcher-cli-ux from blocked/watch to in-progress/focus; the satisfied Local #181 edge is retained. Owner c90bafbb-6e49-4ced-a684-e15cfadfc69e, tracker #179 and PR #180 are unchanged, and PR #180 still needs its own current-head source, design, CI, field-proof and Campaign gates. No readiness, merge, delivery or debt clearance follows. Earlier blocked/pending/watch text below is historical. The builder accepted the minimal command-plus-policy Watcher v2 contract for usability. Runtime core's Application Client holds were discharged on 2026-10-22 under reviewed and reconciled tracker issue #162. On 2026-10-22 the operator approved two Streamliner workflow v2 launches: runtime core launched in owner session 42c1104a-7eb2-477e-a574-2bffb1cd06fe with a shadow merge gate (the operator merges), and the issue #144 optional example pack launched in owner session 76a56ac2-dd56-403f-99e7-9eadb3458ffe as the first live merge-gate pilot. Campaign cleared PR #163 at exact head fdb4f52f, and the owner merged it as 5ad7eb04, completing minimal-example-pack. By operator priority decision on 2026-10-22, Telex Watcher is to replace the waiter session in the operator workflow, and watcher-runtime-core is the intended first owner under the operator workflow v2; that decision records sequencing only. No release, tag, publish, fleet, or I161-1 authority is granted. Operator host-scope direction on 2026-10-22 narrows #162 containment proof to Windows and Linux, requires fail-closed macOS behavior in that node, and creates a focused macOS containment follow-up whose investigation may start after tracker/task reconciliation and whose implementation follows #162 merge. macOS remains a required product platform. This decision does not clear #162's accepted store-binding lifecycle/recovery and premature readiness blockers or its required exact-head review and CI. Campaign launched the macOS containment owner in session d6ee8a1d-e581-4f6c-a42b-77c84bfccc8b on 2026-10-22 with a shadow merge gate; implementation still lands only after #162 merges. macOS containment Phase 1 completed its native investigation with negative evidence for the former arbitrary detached-descendant contract. On 2026-10-22 the operator selected a revised macOS contract for trusted non-detaching detectors; Phase 2 implementation still follows #162 merge. PR #164 for watcher-runtime-core merged on 2026-10-23 as main d0237dbb; #162 remained open; PR #170 merged its documentation correction as main 2513ccda. Post-merge validation found a bounded unsupported-v1 removal/audit defect and a detector-request transport re-encoding defect. Closing PR #173 carried both repairs and merged on 2026-10-23 as main 55cb6b11 at exact head f1c25007, after design approval, independent source review, and all 18 CI checks passed there; issue #162 closed on merge. After exact-merge main CI passed and the #162 field report was posted, the Watcher coordinator completed watcher-runtime-core on 2026-10-23; watcher-cli-ux has its runtime-core prerequisite satisfied and tracker #179. The Watcher coordinator launched its owner session c90bafbb-6e49-4ced-a684-e15cfadfc69e on 2026-10-23 from main 6dc79e40 with the gpt-6.1-sol / high reasoning / default context tier profile. On 2026-10-23 Campaign added the pending external Local cooperative-partial-page-repair dependency under issue #181; watcher-cli-ux delivery is blocked with watch attention. PR #180 and its existing owner remain in place with Watcher-only scope; no root repair is absorbed and its own current-head gates are not waived. The PR #164 merge satisfied the runtime-core prerequisite for macOS Phase 2; PR #168 has since merged the normative ADR/design, and macOS product implementation remains held until a proof-capable plan and final algorithm/evidence authorization are accepted. On 2026-10-23 the design steward conditionally approved the Phase 2 proof shape but kept product implementation held pending clarified PR #168 authority, an updated plan, pinned XNU plus native ARM64/x64 fork/group-empty proof, and final algorithm/evidence authorization. Native ARM64/x86_64 run 39904383638 rejected one-shot SIGKILL completion without producing false absence; the macOS runtime implementation remains held for a separately proved anchored completion transition or decision-needed. On 2026-10-23, under the operator's one-item, one-PR rule, #165 narrowed to the macOS non-detaching detector contract delivered by PR #168, and macOS runtime implementation and proof moved to watcher-macos-containment-runtime under #172, which replaces #165 as the macOS dependency of usable-watcher and closure. Campaign merged PR #168 on 2026-10-23 as main bc1e02ed at exact head 151ade14, and #165 closed on merge. After exact-merge main CI passed and the #165 field report was posted, the Watcher coordinator completed watcher-macos-containment on 2026-10-23. The node watcher-host-containment-doc-alignment under #177 corrected that merged containment text in docs/design/watcher.md. Campaign merged PR #178 at reviewed head 439eeb6c as main b6eac680 on 2026-10-23; after exact-merge main CI passed all 18 jobs on attempt 1 and the field report was posted, the Watcher coordinator completed #177 with watch attention and both documentation debt terminal paths. The #177 prerequisite for #172 product-PR readiness and closure is satisfied; #172's implementation and final authorization HOLD remain unchanged.

nodes.title: Vertical spike: generic external detector runner
nodes.summary: Build one provider-neutral persistent external watcher: trusted local detector commands, versioned structured results, opaque state, fixed Telex target/sender, state commit after durable send, restart recovery, and editable GitHub/Azure DevOps examples including repository-specific filtering. No agent session retains a background waiter.

nodes.title: External detector hosting is broadly useful
nodes.summary: Builder dogfoods materially different GitHub, customized GitHub, Azure DevOps, and non-PR watches. The gate passes only if agents can author detectors quickly, watches survive outside sessions, and Telex wakeup is more reliable and less disruptive than background loop tasks.

nodes.title: Production Watcher contract and application-client requirements
nodes.summary: Promote successful spike semantics into the intended design: detector envelope, watch lifecycle, script pin/follow policy, credentials and environment, failure notification, state/dedup transaction, service identity, message conventions, and the exact requirements exported to the shared Telex Application Client issue #12.

nodes.title: Minimal Watcher authoring and registration contract
nodes.summary: Completed through issue #133 and PR #135, merged as b91e830: command-plus-policy registration, detector request/result v2, runtime-generated event sequence identity, optional hardening, and ADR 0050's narrow supersession of ADR 0046.

nodes.title: Minimal Watcher contract is dumb and useful
nodes.summary: Builder accepts that an agent can write or copy a script and register command, bounds, and route without mandatory manifests, pinning, kind allowlists, provider preflight, downtime declarations, or a prescribed test framework.

nodes.title: Minimal Watcher runtime core
nodes.summary: Implement persistent registry and lifecycle, bounded scheduling/execution, v2 detector protocol, opaque state, runtime-generated event identity, fixed routing, receipt-gated commits, and attempt/health diagnostics under the accepted minimal contract. Launched 2026-10-22 under Streamliner workflow v2 in owner session 42c1104a-7eb2-477e-a574-2bffb1cd06fe on branch lossyrob-watcher-runtime-core; Campaign ran the merge gate and merged at the exact cleared SHA. For this node only, containment proof is Windows and Linux; macOS and other unclaimed hosts fail closed before detector launch, and macOS implementation belongs to `watcher-macos-containment-runtime`. The host decision does not clear the accepted store-binding lifecycle/recovery or premature readiness blockers. On 2026-10-22 PR #164 became ready for operator merge at exact head 40a5c916: independent source review and design inspection accepted the B2 store-binding lifecycle/recovery repair and B3 productionReady fence, and all 18 required CI jobs passed at that head. The operator merged it on 2026-10-23 as main d0237dbb. Issue #162 remained open. PR #170 merged its documentation correction linking the shipped v2 health and event-metadata schemas on 2026-10-23 as main 2513ccda. Post-merge validation found a bounded unsupported-v1 removal/audit defect and a detector-request transport re-encoding defect. Closing PR #173 carried both repairs and merged on 2026-10-23 as main 55cb6b11 at exact head f1c25007, after design approval, independent source review, and all 18 CI checks passed there; issue #162 closed on merge. Exact-merge main CI run 39916429612 passed all 18 checks on attempt 2. The owner posted the #162 field report with design impact updated-docs, and the Watcher coordinator sent completion on 2026-10-23. The node claims Windows and Linux containment only; macOS still fails closed until watcher-macos-containment-runtime lands.

nodes.title: Document the macOS non-detaching detector contract
nodes.summary: Contract item, narrowed on 2026-10-23 under the operator's one-item, one-PR rule. PR #168 must record the operator-selected contract for trusted non-detaching macOS detectors in exactly docs/design/watcher.md and ADR 0054 and say Closes #165: the detector root and all local descendants stay in one Watcher-assigned attempt process group, escape is nonconforming and outside the cleanup guarantee, and Windows and Linux are unchanged. It also records the algorithm-neutral proof boundary, fail-closed guard-loss and restart behavior, the private ephemeral guard authority boundary, and the independence of pending receipt and store reconciliation. It selects no guard or termination algorithm and does not enable macOS execution. Phase 1 native ARM64 and x64 investigation proved that recursive kqueue tracking and ordinary process-group containment cannot satisfy the former arbitrary detached-descendant contract. All Phase 2 work moved to watcher-macos-containment-runtime under #172. PR #168 was an open draft at d4dad4e7 at the split reconciliation. At exact head 151ade14, steward approval, independent review, and all 18 CI checks passed; Campaign's merge gate cleared that head, and Campaign merged it on 2026-10-23 as main bc1e02ed; #165 closed on merge. Exact-merge main CI run 39918260819 passed all 18 checks on attempt 1. The owner posted the #165 field report with design impact updated-docs, and the Watcher coordinator sent completion on 2026-10-23. Owner session d6ee8a1d-e581-4f6c-a42b-77c84bfccc8b held the node through that report; Campaign ran the merge gate and merged at the exact cleared SHA.

It makes no runtime, schema, ADR, or algorithm change and adds no Windows guard or receipt duty. #177 is a prerequisite for #172 product-PR readiness and closure only; it does not stop the active source and native proof work and grants no implementation authorization. The Windows-path five-minute gate does not depend on it. Its only dependency, watcher-macos-containment, completed on 2026-10-23, and the Watcher coordinator launched owner session 99ea868c-1d3c-4ad7-8e1b-69bfb4d41705 on 2026-10-23 from main 91ff6466. Campaign cleared reviewed head 439eeb6c with high confidence and no debt, then merged PR #178 as main b6eac680 on 2026-10-23; #177 closed on merge. Exact-merge main CI run 39985513856 passed all 18 jobs on attempt 1. The owner posted the field report with design impact updated-docs, and the Watcher coordinator completed this node with watch attention and both documentation debt terminal paths. The delivery includes the steward's Linux handshake/receipt amendment. The #177 prerequisite is satisfied, but #172's implementation and final authorization HOLD remain unchanged.

nodes.title: Implement and prove macOS assigned-group containment
nodes.summary: Split from #165 on 2026-10-23 under the operator's one-item, one-PR rule. Implements ordinary-user, per-attempt macOS containment for the trusted non-detaching detector contract and proves it on native ARM64 and x64; one product PR must say Closes #172. Source and native proof work is active. Product integration is held until PR #168 merges, the plan incorporates every design-steward correction, pinned XNU reasoning is mapped to both target releases, barrier-controlled native ARM64 and x64 evidence proves the selected completion algorithm, fork/spawn/exec closure, PID/PGID reuse safety, and no post-seal signal authority, and the design steward gives final authorization. The node also depends on watcher-host-containment-doc-alignment under #177. #177 is a prerequisite for #172 product-PR readiness and closure only; it does not stop the active source and native proof work and grants no implementation authorization. The shipping PR must remove the temporary fail-closed sentence in docs/design/watcher.md and rewrite the macOS containment bullet into unqualified present tense only if the complete runtime implementation, source/native proof, guard-loss/restart behavior, and final design authorization land together at that exact head. Native ARM64/x86_64 run 39904383638 rejected one-shot SIGKILL completion without producing false absence; if no ordinary-user completion predicate can be proved, the node returns decision-needed. The runtime-core merge prerequisite was satisfied by PR #164 merge d0237dbb, and watcher-runtime-core completed on 2026-10-23, so that dependency is satisfied. Any privileged, entitled, installed, persistent, shared, launchd-managed, brokered, or VM-backed architecture returns to the operator. Windows and Linux behavior and all receipt, store, and readiness fences stay unchanged; #162 remains fail-closed on macOS until this node lands. The node does not block the Windows-path five-minute gate, but it blocks product-level usable-watcher and closure. Owner session d6ee8a1d-e581-4f6c-a42b-77c84bfccc8b; Campaign runs the merge gate and merges at the exact cleared SHA.

checkpoints.title: Generic external Watcher proven valuable
checkpoints.summary: A provider-neutral detector loop works outside agent sessions and has been dogfooded across GitHub, Azure DevOps, and custom conditions.

checkpoints.title: Minimal Watcher authoring contract accepted
checkpoints.summary: The intended design supports command-plus-policy registration, agent-owned provider semantics, runtime-generated event identity, and optional hardening without a mandatory template framework.

checkpoints.title: Minimal Watcher runtime, CLI, and examples usable
checkpoints.summary: The supported client, minimal runtime/CLI, and optional examples let agents create, operate, and diagnose watches without session-owned polling or authoring ceremony.

checkpoints.title: Telex Watcher operationally validated
checkpoints.summary: Long-duration external observation and Telex event delivery have survived realistic reliability, security, packaging, and scale validation.

checkpoints.title: Copilot group stall detection validated
checkpoints.summary: A group's root session is woken once, with a snapshot, when every active member of the group has been idle with no wake source for longer than a grace period. The root confirms the stall, diagnoses it, and rings members. The operator can see who is watching what on a status view the root hosts.
